name: Learning
q: No shame in asking what you don't know
Learn till the day you die
Learning without thought is labor lost
A day without reading breeds thorns
To learn is to add day by day
The roots of learning are bitter, its fruit sweet
Trusting all books is worse than none
Know what you know and don't
Love learning and forget old age
Man can only become man by education
Blue dye comes from the indigo plant, yet is bluer than indigo
My life has a limit, but knowledge has none
Only a boy before an ocean of truth
